title: Expected distribution
view: Shared head base (visuals/distribution_bases/head): skeleton bust on the left, grey bust on the right, both turned three-quarters toward the image right so the patient's right cheek and right ear face the viewer; right-sided block.
teachingPoint: A superficial cervical plexus block numbs the neck skin on one side, the skin over the angle of the jaw and the cape of the shoulder, with the collarbone.
claims: Skin: lateral and anterior neck from the lower border of the mandible to the clavicle (transverse cervical), the skin over the angle of the jaw and the lobe (great auricular), the cape of the shoulder (supraclavicular nerves). The lesser occipital territory behind the ear is not visible in this view.
Bone: the clavicle (periosteum; the record lists clavicle fractures as an indication). Not shaded: the face above the jaw line.
Right-sided block (patient's right ear and cheek face the viewer); one tone per nerve, key shown under the image in the app.
